tier_reason: The README shows first-party enwik8 speeds on an AMD Ryzen 5 4500U: Huffman 940.97/1310.28 MB/s versus FSE/Huff0 924.6/1049.5, and TANS 602.56/1022.93 versus FSE/TANS 457.7/572.8. The benchmark driver (etemesi254/zcif_bin) only times this library, so the FSE figures come from a separate tool, and no compiler version or flags are stated.

corrections.caveats: First-party numbers on one file (enwik8). The benchmark driver etemesi254/zcif_bin (MIT, 20 iterations per run, needs rustc 1.58 or later) only times this library's coders, so the FSE/Huff0 and FSE/TANS figures were measured with a different tool; no compiler flags stated. FSE beats this library on compression ratio in both modes (63.26% versus 65.00% for Huffman, 63.12% versus 63.90% for tANS), and the Huffman encode win is under 2%. The repo is declared beta and some files (silesia/mozilla) do not work. No LICENSE file and no license field in Cargo.toml, and the crate is not published on crates.io (404), so the code is reference only.

notes: All numbers match the README. License absence confirmed (no license on the GitHub page, none in Cargo.toml, crate not on crates.io). Metadata confirmed: 14 stars, last commit 2022-08-05 (abandoned), not archived or a fork.
